'''Kester Tolann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. He was the grandson of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wister Tolann]], who had been held back by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] career. As such, Kester Tolann inherited a strong hate for Thrawn's [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], as well as any other [[Non-huMan|non-Human]] species that he felt competed with Humans.

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] conspired with the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Haydnat Treen]], to unite the Imperial Remnant with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and eventually take the place of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] as ruler of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One of their first steps to attain this goal was Lecersen's [[Operation Duusha]], of which Tolann was a part. At the appointed time, Tolann burst into a dining room in the [[Pangalactus]] restaurant&mdash;where [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] was dining with the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]]&mdash;in an attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Fel, although he was quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Unbeknownst to Tolann, Lecersen had planned for him to die during the Operation.
